fields.name: OrleansShardQueryDefinitions query-definition construction family
fields.contract: OrleansShardQueryDefinitions accepts a grain type, a result format, and one definition for each of the read, write, and clear operations. Each operation is independently supplied either as an eager QueryProcedure or as a deferred Lazy<QueryStatement>, yielding all eight eager/deferred combinations. The constructed value preserves the supplied grain type and result format for later observation.
